'''Szark''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] and former associate of [[Jyn Odan/Legends|Jyn Odan]]. Szark betrayed Jyn Odan and made a fortune selling out [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="SWIA">{{SWIA|set=Core Set|mission=High Moon}}</ref>
